# Vendored files

The gallery page inlines these four files, in this order, each followed by its package's
`LICENSE` (spec 0011, AC-71 to AC-73). Each file is the package's `dist/<name>.min.js` and
each `<name>.LICENSE` is the package's own `LICENSE`, both copied unchanged from the npm
tarball on 2026-10-25, after its sha1 matched the registry's `dist.shasum`. All four are ISC.
